audited_facts: proc_pidinfo wrapper directly calls __proc_info without user-space allocation or locks; parent executes it before fork to bind the wrapper.

Child closure measures its own complete descriptor table after fork, refuses insufficient capacity, then closes actual inherited descriptors except its private socket; no resource-limit upper bound or parent snapshot is used.
F_SETNOSIGPIPE lives in shared fileglob flags; both native Macs confirmed dup and /dev/fd reopening mutate the original descriptor state.
EPIPE generates process-wide SIGPIPE on Darwin; helper process confines that signal while caller disposition remains unchanged.
Successful writes record FWASWRITTEN0x10000 independently of output configuration.
prototype_scope: Experimental native controls only; not product code, release acceptance, or source integration changes.
